premise: Beetle and little Psittacosaurus, the two smallest, want to see the purple berries at the very top of Berry Bush; everyone thinks beetles only walk, until Beetle lifts his shiny shell — wings underneath — and flies up to the top.
inspiration: Andersen's 'The Ugly Duckling' turned small and quick: the surprise was folded under his shell all along, and he shares the view.
lesson: Even the smallest may have a surprise to share.
learning: A beetle's hard shiny shell covers a pair of thin wings, folded underneath for flying.

en-US.title: Beetle's Secret
en-US.text: {bush:enter} [curious] Berry Bush was full of berries, red and purple, and the shiniest ones grew at the very top. {psittacosaurus:enter} {psittacosaurus:go to bush} Little Psittacosaurus looked up. {beetle:enter} {beetle:go to psittacosaurus} Beetle looked up too. The two smallest in the valley. "I wish I could see the top," said Psittacosaurus. {beetle:wobble} Beetle tried to climb, and slid right down. {sfx:slide} Bump! {psittacosaurus:face sad} {psittacosaurus:live peek hold} Psittacosaurus sat down small, chin in hands. "Only flyers go up there." {beetle:live wiggle-antennae} Beetle wiggled his antennae. [mischievously] "Then watch this." He lifted up his shiny shell… and underneath were two thin wings, folded small! {beetle:sparkle} {sfx:whirr} Whirrr! {beetle:go on bush by fly} Up flew Beetle to the top. {bush:live laugh} [giggles] "Hee hee! That tickles!" laughed Berry Bush. {beetle:face happy} [excited] "I can see everything!" called Beetle. "The water, the red cliffs far away… and one little Psittacosaurus!" {psittacosaurus:live peek resume} Psittacosaurus peeked up and smiled. {bush:live shake} Berry Bush jiggled, and a purple berry rolled right into his hands. {psittacosaurus:face happy} {psittacosaurus:hop} [happily] And Beetle tucked his wings away under his shiny shell, as if they'd never been there at all.

es-ES.title: El secreto de Escarabajo
es-ES.text: {bush:enter} [curious] Arbusto estaba lleno de bayas rojas y moradas, y las más brillantes crecían arriba del todo. {psittacosaurus:enter} {psittacosaurus:go to bush} El pequeño Psitacosaurio miró arriba. {beetle:enter} {beetle:go to psittacosaurus} Escarabajo también miró. Eran los más pequeños del valle. —Ojalá pudiera ver lo de arriba —dijo Psitacosaurio. {beetle:wobble} Escarabajo intentó trepar, y resbaló hasta abajo. {sfx:slide} ¡Pum! {psittacosaurus:face sad} {psittacosaurus:live peek hold} Psitacosaurio se hizo una bolita, con la barbilla entre las manos. —Allí arriba solo llega quien vuela. {beetle:live wiggle-antennae} Escarabajo movió las antenas. [mischievously] —Pues mira esto. Levantó su caparazón brillante… ¡y debajo tenía dos alas finitas, bien dobladas! {beetle:sparkle} {sfx:whirr} ¡Frrrr! {beetle:go on bush by fly} Escarabajo voló derechito arriba. {bush:live laugh} [giggles] —¡Ji, ji! ¡Me haces cosquillas! —se rio Arbusto. {beetle:face happy} [excited] —¡Lo veo todo! —gritó Escarabajo—. El agua, los riscos rojos a lo lejos… ¡y a un Psitacosaurio pequeñito! {psittacosaurus:live peek resume} Psitacosaurio levantó la cabeza y sonrió. {bush:live shake} Arbusto se sacudió un poquito, y una baya morada rodó hasta sus manos. {psittacosaurus:face happy} {psittacosaurus:hop} [happily] Y Escarabajo volvió a guardar las alas bajo su caparazón, como si nunca hubieran estado ahí.
